messages:
maria: Quick ask — can I get a fast security ok to enable temporary request/response capture in staging to debug a prompt-truncation issue? Plan: 30 minutes for the /v1/generate route only, sample 1% of requests, redact tokens and PII. Config draft below.

maria: ```json
{
  "capture": true,
  "routes": ["/v1/generate"],
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "sampling_pct": 1,
  "redact": {
    "headers": ["authorization", "cookie", "x-api-key"],
    "body_fields": ["email", "phone", "name", "ssn"],
    "prompt_tokens": "redact",
    "hash_user_id": true
  },
  "access": {
    "roles": ["eng-triage", "sec-oncall"],
    "s3_bucket": "s3://redwood-staging-temp-capture",
    "retention_hours": 2
  }
}
```

maria: TL;DR: no full prompt saves, hashed user ids only, 2h retention, no external export. Need sec ok and an approver to grant the S3 role.

sre-oncall: :eyes: important to limit scope. Agree on sampling 1% and route filter. Make sure the capture service uses the ephemeral bucket flag.

devin: +1 on 1%. Also can we add `redact_prompt_templates: true` so higher-level templates don't leak?

lucy: Prefer pseudonymize over full redact for user-visible debugging traces — hashed user id + keep prompt length/structure but strip entities. Is that supported by the capture tool?

maria: capture tool supports `hash_user_id` and `strip_entities` flags. I can enable `strip_entities: true` so we keep shape but remove names/emails.

ashish: Security: I can approve conditional on the following: 1) KMS-encrypted bucket, 2) IAM limited to `eng-triage` and `sec-oncall` for this object prefix, 3) retention enforced via lifecycle rule <= 2 hours, 4) audit logs enabled for both S3 GetObject and role assume, 5) no full prompt field persisted (prompts must be token-redacted or entity-stripped).

ashish: Also need a ticket with owner and run window. Post the ticket link here before running.

maria: Ack. I'll create ENG-4321 and include the run window (tomorrow 02:00 UTC), bucket/KMS ARNs, and exact IAM policy.

audit-bot: Access request logged: request_id=1767504321, requester=maria, action=temporary_capture_request. Waiting for approval.

ashish: Approve (conditional) — I granted provisional approval in-thread. Please attach the ticket and the generated IAM policy to the ticket. I'll re-check the IAM before run. :heavy_check_mark:

maria: Thanks ashish. I'll add `strip_entities: true` and `redact_prompt_templates: true` to the config, create ENG-4321, and ping when IAM role is ready. Keeping retention to 2 hours and sampling 1%.

maria: ENG-4321: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4321 — owner @maria, run window 2026-01-15 02:00 UTC, bucket s3://redwood-staging-temp-capture, KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01, lifecycle rule set to delete objects after 2 hours. IAM policy draft attached in ticket.

audit-bot: Approval recorded: approver=ashish, time=1767505600, note=conditional on IAM/KMS/lifecycle.

devin: :thumbsup: One more ask — add a quick smoke-check consumer that prints only schema diagnostics (no content) so we can triage without seeing prompt text.

maria: yep will add schema-only consumer. I'll post the final config in the ticket and run after IAM sign-off.

ashish: After run, please post the deletion confirmation and S3 delete logs. That closes my approval.

maria: will do. thanks everyone.

lucy: Thanks — appreciate the limited scope and short retention. :white_check_mark:
